desc:
SCOOT IT
Freestyle scooter riding. Push, pump, whip, grind and land it clean.

MAPS
Concrete Wave: a flowing skatepark built for lines.
Downtown Plaza: three levels of stairs, handrails, hubbas and gaps.
Mega Compound: a huge roll-in, a massive gap and full vert.
Custom Park: build your own in a player server.

TRICKS AND COMBOS
Whips, barspins, Bri Flips, grabs, flips, flairs and spins to 720. Grind any rail or ledge, link it all with manuals and land clean to bank the combo. Win tournaments and top the leaderboard.

BUILD YOUR SCOOTER
Pick every part and colour and feel how it r in Community Scoots or ride someone else's.

CONTROLS
PC: W push, S brake, A/D steer and spin, Spatricks, Ctrl nose manual, arrows flip, Q E RF C X G Y Z tricks, V replay and save clips.
Controller: RT push, LT brake, left stick st and D-pad tricks, LB manual, R3 replay.
Mobile: on-screen buttons.
Remap keys in Settings.
